name: selftest_entity_call_refused
about: Harness self-test: `entity_call` drives only an allowlisted retail entry point (an input, Use, touch, think, spawn, damage), never an internal helper. The allowlist is empty, so `UTIL_Remove` (a helper) is refused: the action fails the run as `script` and `expect_fail` turns that into this record's pass. Reported as `fail`, the call ran or its refusal was not reported as a script failure.
